title: Structural variation of protein-ligand complexes of the first bromodomain of BRD4.
authors: Guest, Ellen E; Pickett, Stephen D; Hirst, Jonathan D
one_liner_zh: 该文分析BRD4溴结构域蛋白-配体复合物结构变异与保守水网络，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作和分子对接/自由能模拟，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA，且无TF-DNA结合机制，仅方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: The bromodomain-containing protein 4 (BRD4), a member of the bromodomain and extra-terminal domain (BET) family, plays a key role in several diseases, especially cancers. With increased interest in BRD4 as a therapeutic target, many X-ray crystal structures of the protein in complex with small molecule inhibitors are publicly available over the recent decade. In this study, we use this structural information to investigate the conformations of the first bromodomain (BD1) of BRD4. Structural alignment of 297 BRD4-BD1 complexes shows a high level of similarity between the structures of BRD4-BD1, regardless of the bound ligand. We employ WONKA, a tool for detailed analyses of protein binding sites, to compare the active site of over 100 of these crystal structures. The positions of key binding site residues show a high level of conformational similarity, with the exception of Trp81. A focused analysis on the highly conserved water network in the binding site of BRD4-BD1 is performed to identify the positions of these water molecules across the crystal structures. The importance of the water network is illustrated using molecular docking and absolute free energy perturbation simulations. 82% of the ligand poses were better predicted when including water molecules as part of the receptor. Our analysis provides guidance for the design of new BRD4-BD1 inhibitors and the selection of the best structure of BRD4-BD1 to use in structure-based drug design, an important approach for faster and more cost-efficient lead discovery.
abstract_zh: 含溴结构域蛋白4（BRD4）是溴结构域和末端外结构域（BET）家族的一员，在多种疾病尤其是癌症中发挥关键作用。随着对BRD4作为治疗靶点的兴趣增加，近十年来，许多该蛋白与小分子抑制剂复合物的X射线晶体结构已公开可用。在本研究中，我们利用这些结构信息来探究BRD4第一溴结构域（BD1）的构象。对297个BRD4-BD1复合物的结构比对显示，无论结合的配体如何，BRD4-BD1的结构之间具有高度相似性。我们采用WONKA（一种用于蛋白质结合位点详细分析的工具）来比较其中超过100个晶体结构的活性位点。关键结合位点残基的位置显示出高度的构象相似性，但Trp81除外。我们针对BRD4-BD1结合位点中高度保守的水分子网络进行了重点分析，以确定这些水分子在晶体结构中的位置。通过分子对接和绝对自由能扰动模拟，展示了水分子网络的重要性。当将水分子作为受体的一部分时，82%的配体姿态预测效果更好。我们的分析为设计新的BRD4-BD1抑制剂以及选择最佳的BRD4-BD1结构用于基于结构的药物设计提供了指导，这是一种更快且更具成本效益的先导化合物发现的重要方法。
